in_hebrew.name: Tarrance
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tarrance הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Taras, meaning 'Taurus' or 'Bold'. In Greek mythology, Taras was a god of fishing and agriculture. For Christians, the name Tarrance may represent strength, determination, and courage in one's faith.
